messages.请先阅读并同意使用协议: Please read and agree to the terms of use first
messages.Framely 提供插件的集中安装、管理、运行和更新等功能。第三方插件由各自开发: Framely provides centralized installation, management, execution and updates for plugins. Third-party plugins are provided by their respective developers, who are responsible for their features, content and behavior.
messages.Framely 不保证第三方插件的安全性、可靠性或兼容性。插件库收录、下载校验或: Framely does not guarantee the safety, reliability or compatibility of third-party plugins. Plugin library listings, download verification and permission notices do not constitute approval or a guarantee of plugin safety.
messages.请自行甄别插件来源、安全性及所需权限，谨慎决定是否安装、授权或运行，并备份重要数: Evaluate plugin sources, safety and requested permissions before installing, authorizing or running them, and back up important data. Plugins may read or modify data, access the network or change device settings. Granting elevated permissions may affect your system and device.
messages.在适用法律允许的范围内，因第三方插件的安装、授权、运行、更新或卸载造成的数据丢失: To the extent permitted by applicable law, Framely and its developers are not liable for data loss, privacy breaches, device failures or other losses caused by installing, authorizing, running, updating or uninstalling third-party plugins.
messages.本协议不排除或限制法律规定不得免除或限制的责任及用户权利。: These terms do not exclude or limit any liability or user rights that cannot be excluded or limited by law.
messages.不同意本协议时，请停止使用 Framely。协议发生变更时，需要重新确认。: If you do not agree, stop using Framely. Changes to these terms require renewed agreement.
messages.Framely 本身不会主动收集、上传或出售用户个人信息，不内置用户行为跟踪或遥: Framely itself does not proactively collect, upload or sell users' personal information, and includes no user behavior tracking or telemetry reporting.
messages.为提供管理功能，Framely 会在设备本地保存插件清单、配置、运行日志、协议同: To provide management features, Framely stores plugin lists, settings, runtime logs, agreement records and other necessary state locally on your device. Access passwords are stored only as salted hashes.
messages.获取插件目录、刷新订阅、下载插件和检查更新时，Framely 会按配置访问相应服: When fetching catalogs, refreshing subscriptions, downloading plugins or checking for updates, Framely contacts the configured servers. Requests go through the configured proxy services when enabled. These services may receive your IP address and request information; their operators are responsible for their data handling.
messages.第三方插件可能自行收集、读取或上传用户信息。Framely 不保证插件不会收集信: Third-party plugins may collect, read or upload user information themselves. Framely does not guarantee that plugins will not collect information or that their data handling will meet your privacy expectations.
messages.请查看插件的权限、说明及隐私政策，自行决定是否使用。: Review each plugin's permissions, documentation and privacy policy before deciding whether to use it.
messages.拒绝协议将停用全部插件: Rejecting the terms will disable all plugins
